title: Where distinctive value is likely to be found.
lede: Gelian is currently exploring six areas across Sri Lanka and Australia, in search of opportunities to create lasting value. Each sits at a different stage — from early study to active development.

exploring.label: Exploring
exploring.description: Thesis work — reading the category, meeting operators, and testing whether the opportunity is real.

developing.label: In development
developing.description: Concept and operating model under construction. Not yet trading.

selective.label: Selective
selective.description: Engaging with a small number of specific opportunities rather than the category at large.

active.label: Active interest
active.description: Live conversations and structures in progress. Still not an operating business until it says so plainly.

items.title: Natural Gemstones & Fine Jewellery
items.description: Ceylon sapphires are scarce and sought after by the world's leading jewellers and collectors, and Sri Lanka's tradition of handmade gold and platinum jewellery remains a living craft — one the founder's own family has long been part of.
items.involvement: We are working with an established local house — one that mines its own gemstones, crafts jewellery, and runs a network of retail stores — to build it into an international brand with a global online store.

items.title: Curated Travel & Hospitality
items.description: Sri Lanka and Australia are both island nations with tourism industries built around the ocean, and each draws millions of visitors a year with striking scenery and abundant wildlife. We see room to serve those travellers better — with experiences shaped around what makes each place worth the journey.
items.involvement: We are studying the value chain, aiming at affordable, all-in-one packages — pairing, for example, Sri Lanka's well-priced medical and dental care with wildlife safaris and a cooking class.

items.title: Specialty Agriculture
items.description: Sri Lanka is known the world over for its spices and tea — distinctive in taste and commanding a premium over what other origins produce. Yet much of it still reaches the shelf blended or sold under someone else's label, with the grower and the true origin left anonymous.
items.involvement: We are working with traditional growers to take their tea and spices direct to global markets under their own name — pure, unblended and free of additives, so the true Ceylon character reaches the customer intact and more of the value stays close to source.

items.title: Deep Tech Manufacturing
items.description: Sri Lanka manufactures apparel for many of the world's leading brands — Nike, Victoria's Secret and others. Alongside it, the country has built world-class technical talent, with companies like IFS and the London Stock Exchange running dedicated engineering offices here.
items.involvement: Our founder has spent over a decade in this industry; we are working with him to build AI-driven software that automates apparel design, cutting cost well below the tools in use today.

items.title: Asset Management
items.description: Sri Lanka and Australia each have distinctive asset classes with their own risk-and-return profiles — Australia's housing market and the developments driven by Colombo's Port City are two clear examples. Access to the best of them is usually reserved for those already on the inside.
items.involvement: With a presence in both countries, Gelian is positioned to open a door to some of these undervalued opportunities for prospective investors.

items.title: Education
items.description: Australia is one of the world's most sought-after destinations for higher education — world-class universities across every discipline, with a student-friendly environment and quality of living to match. For students in Sri Lanka, though, actually getting there means navigating cost, paperwork and uncertainty.
items.involvement: We have an active interest in building a bridge between the two countries — one that helps Sri Lankan students study in Australia, closing the gaps in today's process and handling every step end to end.
